events.title: The Merseyside derby at Goodison Park ends in a 1–1 draw, allowing 맨체스터 유나이티드 to cut 리버풀's lead to two points by beating 애스턴 빌라 3–0 at Villa Park. 노팅엄 포리스트's title hopes are fading fast after their fall to another defeat, this time losing 1–0 at 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who grab three points to boost their survival hopes. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 win 3–0 at 입스위치 타운, and 사우샘프턴 boost their hopes of making a late run to the title by beating 노리치 시티 2–1 at The Dell.

European action resumes with four English clubs still in the three cups. 리버풀 beat Portuguese champions 벤피카 1–0 in the European Cup quarter-final first leg at Anfield, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 2–0 to 바르셀로나 in the European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-finals. 노팅엄 포리스트 beat Austrian side 슈투름 그라츠 1–0 at the City Ground in the UEFA Cup quarter-final first leg, while 토트넘 홋스퍼 gain a 2–0 advantage over another Austrian side, Austria Vienna , in their quarter-final first leg. On the First Division scene, 선덜랜드 move closer to safety with a 1–0 home win over QPR.

왓퍼드 reach the FA Cup semi-finals for the first time in 14 years with a 3–1 away win over 버밍엄 시티 in the quarter-final tie at St Andrew's. 에버턴's hopes of a domestic cup double are kept alive as a 2–1 away win over 노츠 카운티 takes them through. One of Home Park 's largest-ever crowds of more than 34,000 sees 플리머스 아가일 keep their FA Cup dream alive, with a goalless draw with 더비 카운티 forcing a replay at the Baseball Ground. First Division action includes victories for leaders 리버풀 and second-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드.
셰필드 웬즈데이 and 사우샘프턴 draw 0–0 in the FA Cup quarter-final at Hillsborough in front of more than 43,000 fans.

Midweek action in the First Division includes a six-goal thriller at Highfield Road , where local rivals 코번트리 시티 and 애스턴 빌라 draw 3-3. 루턴 타운 climb three places to eighth with a 2–1 win over 입스위치 타운, who are now on the brink of the relegation zone just two seasons after finishing as runners-up. 노츠 카운티 keep their survival hopes alive with a 1–0 away win over 노리치 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain in touch with the top two with a 1–0 home win over 에버턴.

FA Cup surprise package 플리머스 아가일 book a semi-final place by beating 더비 카운티 1–0 in the quarter-final replay at the Baseball Ground , four days after the first match ended in a goalless draw at Home Park .

The First Division title race takes something of a surprise turn when 사우샘프턴 beat 리버풀 2–0 at The Dell, putting themselves eight points the leaders with two games in hand, and giving 맨체스터 유나이티드 the chance to go top of the table if they win this weekend.

맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the First Division with a 4–0 home win over 아스널. 노팅엄 포리스트's title challenge is fading as they go down 1–0 at 애스턴 빌라, as is 웨스트햄 유나이티드's following a 4–1 defeat to 레스터 시티 at Filbert Street. 입스위치 타운 drop in the relegation zone after a 1–0 defeat at 에버턴, with 스토크 시티's 2–1 home win over 버밍엄 시티 lifting them out of the bottom three.
사우샘프턴 become the fourth team to reach the FA Cup semi-finals, beating 셰필드 웬즈데이 5–1 in a quarter-final replay at The Dell .

옥스퍼드 유나이티드 , heading for promotion glory under Jim Smith in the Third Division, sign high-scoring 뉴포트 카운티 striker John Aldridge for £78,000. 리버풀 go through to the European Cup semi-finals with a 5–1 aggregate win over 벤피카. Bryan Robson is instrumental with two goals as 맨체스터 유나이티드 overturn a 2–0 deficit against 바르셀로나 to win the second leg of their European Cup quarter-final tie 3–0 and secure their first European semi-final appearance for 15 years. 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 노팅엄 포리스트 both go through to the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup.

사우샘프턴's title hopes are hit by a 4–0 defeat at QPR. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 fall closer towards relegation with a 4–1 defeat at 아스널. Their local rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 move closer to survival with a 3–0 home win over 스토크 시티 in a relegation crunch game at The Hawthorns .
리버풀 and 에버턴 draw 0–0 in the first all- Merseyside Football League Cup final. The match will be replayed at a neutral venue on 28 March.
리버풀 win an unprecedented fourth successive Football League Cup by beating 에버턴 1–0 in the replay at Maine Road with captain Graeme Souness scoring the only goal of the game.

리버풀 return to the top of the First Division with a 2–0 away win over 왓퍼드, as 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 2–0 at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. 아스널's revival continues as they climb up to eighth place with a 4–1 away win over 코번트리 시티.
